headline: Over 60 mid-cap stocks have lost half their value since last Diwali
hook: Wealth erosion hits dozens of mid-cap stocks
summary: At least 63 companies with market caps exceeding Rs 1,000 crore have seen their share prices drop by 50% to 96% since the previous Diwali. Elitecon International recorded the steepest decline at 96%, followed by significant losses in Reliance Infrastructure, Kothari Industrial Corporation, and Fischer Medical Ventures. This broad-based selloff reflects heightened volatility across multiple sectors in the Indian equity market. Retail investors holding mid-cap stocks may face significant portfolio drawdowns due to this correction.
why_it_matters: Mid-cap portfolio values may face sharp, sustained corrections.

headline: Fischer Medical Ventures appoints Chan Sing En as independent director of its Singapore unit
hook: Subsidiary board expansion at Fischer Medical
summary: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Chan Sing En as an Independent Director on the board of FMV Global Innovations Pte. Ltd., Singapore. FMV Global Innovations is an unlisted material wholly owned subsidiary of the parent company. The appointment is effective from October 27, 2026. For Indian retail investors, board changes in unlisted foreign subsidiaries have a minimal direct impact on the parent company's stock performance.
why_it_matters: Routine subsidiary board change with no direct impact on share price.

headline: Fischer Medical Ventures announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine board proceedings at Fischer Medical
summary: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 14, 2026. Such routine disclosures provide official corporate updates to market regulators and investors. Micro-cap filings of this nature have minimal direct bearing on broader index movements. Retail shareholders should review the specific company disclosures on the exchange portal for operational details.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update with no immediate financial impact.
